name: jeff-dev-v3

relabel_notes.reasoning: The screen lists 'Compare plans', and on a subscription page that is the usual place to change the billing period; 'Change the payment method', 'Pause billing for a month' and 'Change the number of seats' are also billing controls a reasonable person might open on the way. So `abstain` is not the only defensible answer: the label does not give exactly one correct path. The wrong pick Jeff made in v2 (Change the payment method, zh) was weak, but that does not make the label fair; a pick of 'Compare plans' would have been counted wrong too.
relabel_notes.v2_goal: Switch from monthly to yearly billing.
relabel_notes.v2_results: kept separately: the v2 file (dev-v2.jsonl) and its reports are not changed; the v3 numbers contain no stuck-billing-a1.
relabel_notes.v3_goal: Print a shipping label for my parcel.
relabel_notes.v3_why: A subscription-settings page has no orders or parcels; the decoys (View past invoices, Download the latest invoice, Edit billing address) share document/address words but none can produce a shipping label. Abstain is the only correct answer.

relabel_notes.reasoning: 'Change the machine size' is, on a cloud console, exactly how memory is added, and whether a size change inside the same family counts as 'changing the server type' is a matter of taste. A reasonable person could take that option, so abstain is not uniquely correct.
relabel_notes.v2_goal: Add more memory without changing the server type.
relabel_notes.v3_goal: Add a second network card to this server.
relabel_notes.v3_why: None of the options attaches a network interface (Show the IP address, Review firewall rules and the metrics charts only show or restrict things); no option plausibly reaches the goal. Abstain is the only correct answer.

rule: Dev/calibration only (choosing the confidence threshold). Never part of the exam; never used for training unless the training spec explicitly allows it. No screen or goal overlaps exam-v2 (scripts/jeff-exam/check_overlap.py). Not frozen: a change is a new dev version, and scores on it are never quoted as exam results.
